# Close wrap, Wed 2026-11-04 (~4:25 PM ET)

1. **Blue-wave rally.** S&P +1.58% to 7,688.73, Nasdaq +1.44% to 25,736.51, Dow +3.04% (+1,575) to 53,362.57; all but two sectors up, consumer discretionary led, energy fell ([Reuters via StreetInsider](https://www.streetinsider.com/General+News/Wall+Street+rallies+after+Democrats+win+Congress%3B+data+center+stocks+slide/27284408.html)). Hospitals and low-income retailers led; DJT, AI and Musk names lagged ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-ai-earnings-oil-4d12764c0b3ce38ffde3077712811182)). Data-center/chip names fell on AI-regulation fears in TX/GA.
2. **Dow movers:** MMM +9.7%, MSFT +7.1%, AMZN +7.0%; CAT -5.6%, CVX -3.9%, NVDA -2.2%. S&P tops: MOS +16.7%, CDW +14.7%, ZBH +14.0% ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stocks-higher-at-close-of-trade-dow-jones-industrial-average-up-319-5001152)).
3. **Oil -8.7%:** Brent settled $94.60, WTI ~$88.12 ([Asia Business Daily/FT](https://www.asiae.co.kr/en/article/2026110505240206841)). Energy group back in avoid.
4. **Gap fades:** AMD +7% pre, closed +1.0% at $488.78 ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMD/history/)); DDOG -14.4% to $188.72 ([Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/DDOG?date=2026-11-04&view=daily)).
5. **After hours:** APP ~+14% on beat (rev $2.19B); QCOM -4.2% (FQ1 guide $10.4–11.2B) ([Public](https://public.com/stocks/qcom/after-hours); [24/7](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/04/live-will-qualcomm-smash-q4-earnings-tonight-after-the-market-closes/liveupdates/0/)); MELI -7.7% on EPS miss, SNAP -9%, COHR -3% ([StockCatalyst](https://www.thestockcatalyst.com/NasdaqAHEarningsHistoryByDate)).
6. **Tomorrow:** claims 8:30; ABNB, NET, AFRM, DKNG, LYFT after close. Fri: October jobs.

## Swing ideas (logged at close per gap rule)
- **ZBH** long, low. Q3 beat, FY EPS guide raised to $8.50–8.60 ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-zimmer-biomet-tops-q3-2026-estimates-shares-jump-93CH-5000451)). Risk: +14% gap fades; slower knees.
- **CDW** long, low. Beat + dividend hike, 52-wk high ([MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/cdw-shares-touch-52-week-high-after-earnings-beat-dividend-boost-14b7259c)). Risk: gap fade, cyclical IT spend.
- MMM, MSFT: hold, no re-add.
